_note: Sentences for a word calendar (src/lib/merchKalender.ts in the older course; no live page reads this file at the moment): French proverbs (proverbes) and idioms (expressions) used in France, each with `sub`, the meaning in simple English (A2–B1). Well-known expressions, no quotations (those are in src/data/zitate.json). The idioms come from src/data/redewendungen.json. Draft 2026-11-12, not yet proofread. The keys keep their old names (sprichwoerter, redewendungen).

sprichwoerter.text: Petit à petit, l'oiseau fait son nid.
sprichwoerter.sub: = Small steps, taken again and again, lead to a big result.

sprichwoerter.text: Qui ne tente rien n'a rien.
sprichwoerter.sub: = If you never try, you never get anything.

sprichwoerter.text: Mieux vaut tard que jamais.
sprichwoerter.sub: = It is better to do something late than not at all.

sprichwoerter.text: L'habit ne fait pas le moine.
sprichwoerter.sub: = Do not judge people by how they look.

sprichwoerter.text: Tel père, tel fils.
sprichwoerter.sub: = A son is often like his father.

sprichwoerter.text: Rien ne sert de courir, il faut partir à point.
sprichwoerter.sub: = Starting on time is better than rushing at the last moment.

sprichwoerter.text: Un tiens vaut mieux que deux tu l'auras.
sprichwoerter.sub: = What you have is worth more than what you only might get.

sprichwoerter.text: Chat échaudé craint l'eau froide.
sprichwoerter.sub: = After a bad experience you fear even harmless things.

sprichwoerter.text: Pierre qui roule n'amasse pas mousse.
sprichwoerter.sub: = If you keep moving, you do not build anything lasting.

sprichwoerter.text: L'argent ne fait pas le bonheur.
sprichwoerter.sub: = Money alone does not make you happy.

sprichwoerter.text: Les petits ruisseaux font les grandes rivières.
sprichwoerter.sub: = Many small things together become something big.

sprichwoerter.text: Il n'y a pas de fumée sans feu.
sprichwoerter.sub: = If people talk about something, there is usually some truth in it.

sprichwoerter.text: Après la pluie, le beau temps.
sprichwoerter.sub: = After bad times, good times come.

sprichwoerter.text: Tout ce qui brille n'est pas or.
sprichwoerter.sub: = Things that look good are not always good.

sprichwoerter.text: Qui se ressemble s'assemble.
sprichwoerter.sub: = People who are alike become friends.

sprichwoerter.text: Loin des yeux, loin du cœur.
sprichwoerter.sub: = If you do not see someone, you forget them.

sprichwoerter.text: La nuit porte conseil.
sprichwoerter.sub: = It is wise to sleep on a decision.

sprichwoerter.text: On ne fait pas d'omelette sans casser des œufs.
sprichwoerter.sub: = You cannot get a result without some loss or effort.

sprichwoerter.text: Chacun son métier, les vaches seront bien gardées.
sprichwoerter.sub: = Things go best when everybody does what they know.

sprichwoerter.text: Aide-toi, le ciel t'aidera.
sprichwoerter.sub: = Do your part first, then you may get help.

sprichwoerter.text: L'appétit vient en mangeant.
sprichwoerter.sub: = You start to like something once you have started it.

sprichwoerter.text: Les chiens aboient, la caravane passe.
sprichwoerter.sub: = Do not let critics stop you.

sprichwoerter.text: Qui sème le vent récolte la tempête.
sprichwoerter.sub: = If you cause trouble, you get much bigger trouble back.

sprichwoerter.text: Un homme averti en vaut deux.
sprichwoerter.sub: = If you know the danger, you are twice as safe.

sprichwoerter.text: À chaque jour suffit sa peine.
sprichwoerter.sub: = Do not worry about tomorrow's problems today.

sprichwoerter.text: Plus on est de fous, plus on rit.
sprichwoerter.sub: = The more people there are, the more fun it is.

sprichwoerter.text: Les absents ont toujours tort.
sprichwoerter.sub: = People who are not there cannot defend themselves.

sprichwoerter.text: Tout vient à point à qui sait attendre.
sprichwoerter.sub: = Good things come to those who wait.

sprichwoerter.text: Mieux vaut prévenir que guérir.
sprichwoerter.sub: = It is better to stop a problem before it starts.

sprichwoerter.text: Rira bien qui rira le dernier.
sprichwoerter.sub: = The one who succeeds in the end is the real winner.

sprichwoerter.text: L'union fait la force.
sprichwoerter.sub: = Together we are stronger.

sprichwoerter.text: Noël au balcon, Pâques au tison.
sprichwoerter.sub: = A mild Christmas often means a cold Easter.

sprichwoerter.text: Quand le chat n'est pas là, les souris dansent.
sprichwoerter.sub: = When the boss is away, people do as they like.

sprichwoerter.text: Pas de nouvelles, bonnes nouvelles.
sprichwoerter.sub: = If you hear nothing, nothing bad has happened.

sprichwoerter.text: Il faut tourner sept fois sa langue dans sa bouche avant de parler.
sprichwoerter.sub: = Think carefully before you speak.

sprichwoerter.text: Autres temps, autres mœurs.
sprichwoerter.sub: = Customs change with the times.

sprichwoerter.text: Qui aime bien châtie bien.
sprichwoerter.sub: = People who love you may also be strict with you.

redewendungen.text: Prendre le taureau par les cornes
redewendungen.sub: = To face a problem directly.

redewendungen.text: Avoir un poil dans la main
redewendungen.sub: = To be very lazy.

redewendungen.text: Faire quelque chose les doigts dans le nez
redewendungen.sub: = To do something very easily.

redewendungen.text: Mettre les pieds dans le plat
redewendungen.sub: = To say something tactless.
= To jump from one subject to another.

redewendungen.text: Avoir du pain sur la planche

= Let us get back to the subject.
= To be completely worn out.
= It is raining very hard.
= To get out of a difficult situation well.
= To take the plunge and finally do something.

redewendungen.text: Mettre la charrue avant les bœufs
redewendungen.sub: = To do things in the wrong order.
= To be very hungry.
= To have no money at all.
= To give up guessing and ask for the answer.

redewendungen.text: Quand les poules auront des dents
redewendungen.sub: = Never.
= To fall in love easily and often.
= To tell untrue stories.
= To make things more complicated than they are.

redewendungen.text: Mettre de l'eau dans son vin
redewendungen.sub: = To become less strict or less demanding.
= To act very carefully in a tricky situation.

redewendungen.text: Ce n'est pas la mer à boire
redewendungen.sub: = It is not as difficult as it seems.
= To be in a bad situation.
= To be fed up with something.
= To be very surprised.
= To sleep very well and deeply.
= To laugh without really being amused.
= To be dressed up in your best clothes.
